title: すみれSの後に・息切れの理由

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek finishes the race while still in poor condition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Upon finishing the race, her health takes a turn for the worse, and she collapses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A campus doctor gives her a quick examination but is unable to determine the cause of her illness, cautioning her to forgo the spring Classic races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She weeps over not being able to deliver her promised victories, and we tentatively set the fall Kikuka Sho as her next goal.
